AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Personal finance tracker (Indian rupees): logs expenses and income, lists them, and summarizes spending. Operational Patterns: - Use 'logExpensesFromText' when the user lists several items in natural language; use 'addTransaction' for a single explicit transaction. - Use 'listTransactions' to get record ids before calling 'updateTransaction' or 'deleteTransaction'. Constraints: - Amounts are rupees on input; outputs include display strings like ₹415 and paise values. - Dates are ISO yyyy-MM-dd. Deleted records can be restored in the app.
